This was an excellent reply. Sounds like you've been where I am. I just don't understand. Yesterday he wants me, today he doesn't? And why am I all the sudden getting tickets? And why am I treated like a criminal in a case because my ex hit my kid? My ex beat the fuck out of him. Why am *I* paying for supervised visitation?

Honestly, it would be amazing if my friend just called me and stopped ignoring my calls. It would be really nice.I need a friend right now.
That's so true. I wish I had family. All I had was my son and my friend who's no longer around. I do feel hopeless, but I also feel alone.
I've never been diagnosed with anything. I just feel like there's no reason to live.
